document.whyFallback: Improves the security, speed or reliability of the site.

why.sec-hsts: Browsers now always use the encrypted connection, so visitors cannot be pushed onto an insecure one, for example on public Wi-Fi.
why.sec-nosniff: Browsers no longer guess file types, which closes a trick for running disguised scripts.
why.sec-referrer-policy: Full page addresses, which can contain private details, are no longer passed on to other websites.
why.sec-frame-options: Other sites can no longer embed your pages invisibly to trick visitors into clicking (clickjacking).
why.sec-csp: A Content-Security-Policy is being tested: the strongest browser defence against injected scripts.
why.wp-xmlrpc: Closes an old interface that attackers use to guess passwords in bulk.
why.wp-user-enumeration: Usernames are no longer listed publicly, so attackers have one less half of a login to guess.
why.wp-file-editing: Even with a stolen admin password, nobody can change the site's code from the dashboard.
why.wp-core-auto-updates: WordPress security releases now install automatically, usually within hours of release.
why.wp-open-admin-registration: New sign-ups no longer receive administrator rights, closing a direct way to take over the site.
why.wp-config-permissions: The file holding the database password can no longer be read by other accounts on the server.
why.wp-plugin-auto-updates: Plugins now receive security fixes automatically instead of waiting for someone to click update.
why.wp-expired-transients: Expired cached data was removed, keeping the database lean and the site responsive.
why.wp-revisions: Old page revisions were cleaned up, keeping the database smaller and backups faster.
why.wp-outdated-plugins: Plugins were updated with a restore point, closing known security holes and bugs.
why.red-flag-core-modifications: Altered WordPress system files were replaced with official, verified copies.
why.red-flag-unexpected-core-files: Unknown files in WordPress system folders were moved to quarantine, where they cannot run.
